scripts.text:
^3355FFWait a minute! You're
carrying too many items
right now: store some of
your extra things in Kafra
Storage, and then come back.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF等一下！
你現在攜帶的物品太多了：請將多餘的東西存入卡普拉倉庫，然後再回來。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou're not sure why, but
this guy seems to be pretty
depressed. He briefly makes
eye contact with you, but then
breaks it off. Apparently,
he wants to be left alone.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你不確定原因，但這傢伙看起來相當沮喪。
他短暫地與你目光接觸，隨即移開了視線。
顯然，他想一個人待著。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere's no reason for you
to stick around an ownerless
stronghold. You may as well
head on your way.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你沒必要在一個沒有主人的據點逗留。
你最好還是離開吧。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, you're back. So did you
rest up enough? I'm sure the
other guild members are
feeling refreshed by now.
From the looks of it, you're
ready for your next mission.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦，你回來了。
休息得足夠了嗎？
我想其他公會成員現在應該也恢復精神了。
看你的樣子，已經準備好迎接下一個任務了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The next step for
you is to take this, the
''Spirit of Trust.'' If this
guild is going to be solid,
you need to think how much
trust there is in the guild.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
接下來，請收下這枚“信賴之心”。要讓公會穩固發展，就得想想成員之間有多少信任。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Your second test will be
to give that ^4D4DFFSpirit of Trust^000000
to a sage that can manipulate
nature's attributes. In other
words, a Sage or Scholar
must carry out this task.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你的第二個考驗是將^4D4DFF信賴之心^000000交給一位能操縱自然屬性的賢者。
換句話說，必須由賢者或學者來完成這項任務。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The Spirit of Trust must
be delivered to ^4D4DFF{1}^000000,
so don't forget to relay
that information to your
Sage or Scholar. Very well,
good luck on your journey.

[{0}]

[{0}]
Ah, did you rest we-- Oh.
Why do you look so pale?
You can't accomplish great

[{0}]
Ah, you look well rested,
master. It is now time for
you to proceed with the third
test. Let me remind you that
these spirits are incredibly
precious. Do not lose them.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
啊，會長，看來你休息得不錯。現在該進行第三項考驗了。提醒你，這些信物都非常珍貴，千萬別弄丟。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Like all the other spirits,
please keep this one safely.
This is the ^4D4DFFSpirit of Peace^000000.
It seems contradictive that
strongholds and might can
bring peace, but it's true.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
和其他信物一樣，請妥善保管這枚^4D4DFF和平之心^000000。據點和武力竟能帶來和平，聽起來似乎自相矛盾，但事實確實如此。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
If power isn't used to
protect the weak, then
some bully, in one form or
another, will always come
to exploit them. That is why
Tristan III built the strongholds.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
如果力量不用於保護弱者，總會有惡霸以某種形式出現並剝削他們。這就是特里斯坦三世建立據點的原因。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Please dispatch a Rogue
or Stalker to bring this
Spirit of Peace to ^4D4DFF{1}^000000.
If you don't know any Rogues
or Stalkers, then it would be
prudent for you to meet one.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
請派一名流氓或神行太保把和平之心交給^4D4DFF{1}^000000。如果公會裡沒有流氓或神行太保，現在正是結識一位的好機會。

[{0}]
Ah, have you rested well,
master? Please excuse my
manners a while ago. I had
to report your trial results,
and lost my composure for a
moment. It won't happen again.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
啊，會長，您休息得好嗎？請原諒我剛才失禮了。我剛才要彙報您的考驗結果，一時有些失態。不會再發生了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh! M-master? Wh-when
did you...? I'm so sorry.
I was busy working.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦！會...會長？您...您什麼時候來的？非常抱歉，我剛才在忙工作。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It's only been a few days
since you finished the trials.
For now, you should rest and
take care of your guild, okay?
Please come back later.
I've got much to attend to...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你完成考驗才過了幾天。現在先休息一下，照看好公會吧。請稍後再來找我，我還有很多事要處理...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Good day, master.
Is something wrong?
You look as though
something is on your mind.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
會長，您好。有什麼事嗎？您看起來好像有心事。

scripts.text: N-no, nothing.
scripts.translation: 不，不，沒什麼。

scripts.text: I want to take a lesson.
scripts.translation: 我想接受一次考驗

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hm? That's strange.
You didn't want to take
the trials again, did you?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯？真奇怪。
你不是想再參加一次考驗嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]

be easy, but I suppose you
are prepared. Here, take
the ^4D4DFFSpirit of Guild^000000, and
give it to your most trusted
Knight or Lord Knight.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我明白了。
你知道這並不容易，但我相信你已經做好了準備。
請收下^4D4DFF公會之心^000000，並將其交給你最信任的騎士或騎士領主。

may the gods be with you.

scripts.text:
[{0}]

the Spirit of Guild over
to ^4D4DFFAtila^000000. Good luck, and
may the gods be with you.
scripts.translation:

這位騎士應將公會之靈帶到^4D4DFF阿提拉^000000。祝你好運，願諸神與你同在。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You still have the Spirit of
Guild I gave you? I suppose
you haven't found a Knight or
Lord Knight to which it can
be entrusted. It is imperative
that you find someone soon.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你還留著給你的公會之心嗎？
看來你還沒找到可以託付的騎士或騎士領主。
你必須儘快找到合適的人選。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
For the sake of the guild, it
will be advantageous to have
a Knight or Lord Knight on
your side: their combat skills
can turn the tide of battles.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
為了公會的利益，擁有一位騎士或騎士領主會很有利：他們的戰鬥技巧可以扭轉戰局。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
When you do find a Knight,
give him the Spirit of Guild
and ask him to find {1}
since he will conducting
the trial. Good luck
to you, master.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ah, is this the Spirit
of Advance? This must mean
that you completed the first
test. Keep up the good work.
Hand me the spirit, and allow
me to give you your guild's reward.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
啊，這是前進之心嗎？看來你完成了第一項考驗。幹得好。
把信物交給我，我來把公會的獎勵給你。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You've done well, but
there are more trials
ahead of you. For now,
you should rest before
undertaking the second test.
Please come when you are ready.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你做得很好，但前方還有更多考驗。
現在先休息一下，再進行第二項考驗。準備好後再來找我。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
If you're not busy, then
why don't you spend your
time increasing morale
among your guild members?
Perhaps some team building
exercise can be of help.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
如果你不忙的話，為什麼不花點時間提升公會成員計程車氣呢？
也許一些團隊建設活動會有幫助。

[{0}]

[{0}]

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ah, so you already completed
the test and earned the Spirit
of Friendship? Good work.
You must now recognize the
value of teamwork. Please give
the Spirit of Friendship to me.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
啊，你已經完成考驗並獲得了友情之心？幹得好。
你現在應該明白團隊合作的價值了。請把友情之心交給我。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Now, please take this
reward and share it with
your guild members. This
may come in handy in future
challenges that you will all
face together. Good work!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
現在，請收下這份獎勵，並與你的公會成員分享。
這在你們共同面對未來的挑戰時可能會有用。
幹得好！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You should rest and
recuperate before you
undertake the third test.
I too would benefit from
a brief respite. Please come
back to me when you are ready.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
進行第三項考驗前，你最好先休息、恢復體力。我也正好需要短暫歇息。準備好後再來找我。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
If you're not busy, then
why don't you spend your
time increasing morale
among your guild members?
Perhaps some team building
exercise can be of help.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
如果你不忙的話，為什麼不花點時間提升公會成員計程車氣呢？
也許一些團隊建設活動會有幫助。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
If it suits your fancy,
you may simply come here
and join me for a cup of tea.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
如果你願意的話，可以來這裡和我一起喝杯茶。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You still have the
Spirit of Peace? If you
don't have any Rogues or
Stalkers in your guild, now
would be the time to recruit
them. Heed my advice...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你還留著和平之心嗎？
如果公會裡沒有流氓或神行太保，現在正是招募他們的時候。
記住我的建議...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I see that you've completed
the last test and received
the Spirit of Victory. Heh.
Victory is the natural result
when your guild works together
in harmony as a united team.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
看來你完成了最後一項考驗，並獲得了勝利之心。呵。
公會成員齊心協力、團結合作，自然就能取得勝利。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Congratulations on
completing all the trials.
Please accept this reward,
given on the behalf of King
Tristan III, and share it with
guild. Once again, good work.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
恭喜你完成了所有考驗。請收下這份特里斯坦三世國王頒發的獎勵，並與公會成員分享。再次恭喜，幹得好。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You and your guild must be
quite tired now. Your rooms
are ready for you if you decide
to rest. Please visit me again
if you wish to take the trials
again. I'll see you later.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你和你的公會一定累壞了吧。
如果你們想休息，房間已經準備好了。
如果想再次接受考驗，請隨時再來找我。
後會有期。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
If you aren't particularly
busy, then why don't you
spend some time with your
guild members? Building
strong camaraderie never
fails to pay off. Never.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
如果你不忙的話，為什麼不花點時間和公會成員相處呢？
建立牢固的友誼總是會有回報的。
絕對如此。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Greetings, master.
I am {1}, one of the four
Great Sages, and I am here
to serve you under the orders
of wise and benevolent
King Tristan III.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
會長，向您致意。我是{1}，四大賢者之一，奉英明仁慈的特里斯坦三世國王之命前來為您效勞。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
We test guilds that own
strongholds, and see if they
are qualified to be considered
elite guilds. Our goal is to
train guilds to strengthen
our military forces.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我們會考驗擁有據點的公會，判斷它們是否有資格成為精英公會。我們的目標是訓練公會，增強軍事實力。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Although your guild has the
strength and courage to conquer
a stronghold, we want you to
prove that your guild has
a strong sense of justice,
honor, and compassion.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
雖然你的公會有徵服據點的力量和勇氣，但我們希望你們證明，你們的公會擁有強烈的正義感、榮譽感和同情心。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It is up to you. Will
you take the test I have
for you? I will do my best to
help your guild grow stronger
so that you will be better
able to protect the weak.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這取決於你。
你願意接受我為你準備的考驗嗎？
我會盡力幫助你的公會變得更強，以便你們能更好地保護弱者。

scripts.text: I want to take the test.
scripts.translation: 我想接受考驗

scripts.text: Let me think about it.
scripts.translation: 讓我考慮一下

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Is that so? In this test,
you will be given orders
and special spirits. These
spirits will only be given
once: you must not lose them.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是嗎？這項考驗會給你任務指示和特殊信物。每件信物只會發放一次，千萬不能弄丟。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
If you lose the spirit,
you will be judged as
irresponsible, and will be
unable to complete the tests.
You must find any lost spirit to
proceed. There's no second chance.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
如果弄丟信物，你會被判定為不負責任，也無法完成考驗。必須找回丟失的信物才能繼續，沒有第二次機會。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
There are a few things you
should know. Firstly, you can
only take care of one spirit
at a time. Secondly, you need
to do the tests in order and
follow the guide's instructions.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
有幾件事你需要知道。首先，你一次只能保管一件信物。其次，你必須按順序參加考驗，並遵循嚮導的指示。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Thirdly, the spirit should
be given to the type of person
specified in the test. Those
are the rules. Remember them.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
第三，你必須把信物交給考驗中指定職業的人。這些就是規則，記住。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Okay, this is the first
spirit that will be entrusted
to you. Make sure to give this
to a Knight or Lord Knight.
The test has now officially
begun. Good luck to you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好，這是第一件託付給你的信物。務必交給一位騎士或騎士領主。考驗現在正式開始。祝你好運。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I suppose it would be
a good idea to discuss
this with your guild before
you decide to commit to
taking the test. Feel free
free to visit me again later.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
決定接受考驗之前，最好先和公會商量一下。稍後歡迎再來找我。

[{0}]

guild must have solidarity

[{0}]

scripts.text:
[{0}]

quality time with your
guild members, and get
a chance to really learn
who they are? You must
love your comrades.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你和公會成員們相處得愉快嗎？有沒有機會真正瞭解他們？
你一定很珍惜自己的同伴。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Now you know how
important bonding truly
is. Please give this spirit
to a ^42426FBard^000000, ^42426FMinstrel^000000, ^42426FDancer^000000,
or ^42426FGypsy^000000. Good luck to you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
現在你知道建立羈絆有多重要了。請把這枚信物交給^42426F詩人^000000、^42426F宮廷樂師^000000、^42426F舞娘^000000或^42426F冷豔舞姬^000000。祝你好運。

[{0}]

best for you to rest and
recoup your strength. Your
chance to help your guild
will come soon enough so
there's no need to rush.

[{0}]

for the right time to act.

your guild in the meantime?

[{0}]

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I see that you have
the potential to become
a great leader. Be sure
not to waste it, and lead
your guild as well as you can.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
看來你有成為偉大領袖的潛力。
務必不要浪費它，並盡你所能領導你的公會。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You need to give
the ^FF0000Spirit of Victory^000000
to your Guild Master.
Please make sure that
it gets delivered soon.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你需要將^FF0000勝利之心^000000交給你的公會會長。
請確保儘快送達。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You're a nenown explorer,
and I see in you the potential
to accomplish even more
great things. However,
I doubt there is anything
more that you can do here.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你是一位聲名遠揚的探索者，我看出你有潛力成就更偉大的事業。
不過，我想這裡已經沒有更多你能做的事了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hmm. You have no business
being here. Why don't you
find something productive
to do? There is nothing
for you here, I assure you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯。
你不該出現在這裡。
何不找點有意義的事做？
我向你保證，這裡對你毫無用處。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You might be the master
of a guild, but you and I
have nothing to do with
each other. I'm sorry.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你或許是公會的會長，但你和我毫無關係。
抱歉。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Then again, I suppose
you came here to see
how a real guild operates.
If that's the case, you're
welcome to stay and observe.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不過，我想你來這裡是為了看看真正的公會是如何運作的。
如果是這樣，歡迎留下來觀察。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What brings you here?
I don't think I've seen
you around before. Hm.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
什麼事把你帶到這兒？
我想我從未見過你。
嗯。
